# Which of your Whatnot shows and categories actually make money?

> Free analyzer for Whatnot sellers: load your orders CSV and see profit per sale, show and category after Whatnot commission and payment processing, with effective fee rate, cost basis by SKU, low-price sale drag and the shows and categories that lose money. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
